UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; ROOT=\"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; BASE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; TMP=\"${ROOT}.amp-install\"; TOOLS=\"${ROOT}.tools\"; SPT_URL=\"https://spt-releases.modd.in/SPT-4.1.2-40743-cf04a11.7z\"; if [ -x \"$BASE/SPT.Server.Linux\" ] && [ -d \"$BASE/SPT_Data\" ]; then echo \"[SPT] SPT 4.1.2 already installed - skipping download.\"; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p \"$BASE\" \"$TMP\" \"$TOOLS\"; if [ ! -x \"$TOOLS/7zzs\" ]; then echo \"[SPT] Downloading 7-Zip...\"; curl -fL --retry 3 \"https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-linux-x64.tar.xz\" -o \"$TMP/7z.tar.xz\"; tar -xJf \"$TMP/7z.tar.xz\" -C \"$TOOLS\"; chmod +x \"$TOOLS/7zzs\"; fi; echo \"[SPT] Downloading SPT 4.1.2...\"; curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 3 \"$SPT_URL\" -o \"$TMP/SPT.7z\"; rm -rf \"$TMP/extract\"; mkdir -p \"$TMP/extract\"; \"$TOOLS/7zzs\" x -y -aoa \"$TMP/SPT.7z\" \"-o$TMP/extract\" >/dev/null; SRC=\"\"; if [ -f \"$TMP/extract/SPT/SPT.Server.Linux\" ]; then SRC=\"$TMP/extract/SPT\"; elif [ -f \"$TMP/extract/SPT.Server.Linux\" ]; then SRC=\"$TMP/extract\"; else FOUND=\"$(find \"$TMP/extract\" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name SPT.Server.Linux -print -quit)\"; [ -n \"$FOUND\" ] || { echo \"[SPT] ERROR: SPT.Server.Linux not found\"; exit 20; }; SRC=\"$(dirname \"$FOUND\")\"; fi; echo \"[SPT] Installing from $SRC to $BASE\"; find \"$BASE\" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} +; cp -a \"$SRC\"/. \"$BASE\"/; chmod +x \"$BASE/SPT.Server.Linux\"; find \"$BASE\" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name \"*.Linux\" -exec chmod +x {} +; find \"$BASE\" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name \"*.sh\" -exec chmod +x {} +; test -x \"$BASE/SPT.Server.Linux\"; test -d \"$BASE/SPT_Data\"; rm -rf \"$TMP\"; echo \"[SPT] SPT 4.1.2 installation complete.\""

-c "set -euo pipefail; BASE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; ROOT=\"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; TMP=\"${ROOT}.fika-install\"; FIKA_DIR=\"$BASE/user/mods/fika-server\"; if [ -d \"$FIKA_DIR\" ]; then echo \"[FIKA] Fika Server already installed - skipping download.\"; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p \"$TMP\"; echo \"[FIKA] Resolving Fika Server 2.4.0 release...\"; curl -fsSL -H \"Accept: application/vnd.github+json\" \"https://api.github.com/repos/project-fika/Fika-Server-CSharp/releases/tags/v2.4.0\" -o \"$TMP/release.json\"; FIKA_URL=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(next(a[\"browser_download_url\"] for a in d[\"assets\"] if a[\"name\"]==\"Fika.Server.Release.2.4.0.zip\"))' \"$TMP/release.json\")\"; [ -n \"$FIKA_URL\" ] || { echo \"[FIKA] ERROR: Release asset not found\"; exit 30; }; echo \"[FIKA] Downloading Fika Server 2.4.0...\"; curl -fL --retry 3 \"$FIKA_URL\" -o \"$TMP/fika.zip\"; echo \"[FIKA] Extracting into SPT installation...\"; python3 -c 'import zipfile,sys; zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).extractall(sys.argv[2])' \"$TMP/fika.zip\" \"$BASE\"; test -d \"$BASE/user/mods/fika-server\" || { echo \"[FIKA] ERROR: fika-server directory missing after extraction\"; exit 31; }; rm -rf \"$TMP\"; echo \"[FIKA] Fika Server 2.4.0 installation complete.\""
